title: Art bible · World and settlements
summary:
**One world, three zoom levels:** city → several-city region → almost the whole continent. The new v002 sequence shares a north-up overhead camera, warm isekai palette, the same central city and recognisable geography.

[Collected references](#/world-in-dreams/7) are in **Art bible → References**. The two earlier concepts are preserved below the new sequence. These are concept images, not simulation exports; fine details may simplify between scales.

items.title: Zoom 01 · City — v002
items.alt: Overhead city map with a circular market west of a winding river, northeast citadel, southeast warehouses and surrounding farmland.
items.body:
**Close view.** The approved city reworked towards a vertical roof-plan view. Follow the circular market, river, northeast citadel and southeast storage quarter through the next two images.

Built-in image generation; input: the earlier city concept. Generated proposal, awaiting review.
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. WORLD IN DREAMS â€” coherent zoom series, frame 1 of 3, CITY. Edit/recreate the supplied city reference into a STRICT NADIR ORTHOGRAPHIC PLAN VIEW, camera exactly 90 degrees above ground. The most important correction is camera: only roofs and the TOP surfaces of walls and tree crowns, absolutely NO building fronts, side elevations, isometric projection, oblique camera or horizon. Circular towers must have circular roof plans, the outer city footprint is roughly circular rather than a perspective ellipse. This is a game map viewed directly down, not a bird's eye landscape illustration.
Keep the reference's appealing moderately stylised anime fantasy painting, warm terracotta roofs, pale sandstone, yellow-green farmland, dark green tree crowns and clear blue water. Hand-painted crisp shapes and rich but restrained detail; unified soft daylight, negligible short shadows.
Recreate its distinctive layout as an ORIGINAL CITY reusable in subsequent zoomed out frames: almost circular walled town; river enters at 12 o'clock, curves to the right of the central circular market and leaves at 6 o'clock; three main bridge crossings at northern, central and southern sections; citadel precinct in the northeast quadrant with a roofed keep and four rectangular garden beds; large circular central market WEST of river; warehouse/granary quarter in the southeast; four principal gates at north east south west. Dense terracotta roof neighbourhoods with irregular readable streets; roads continue through the gates, farmland and groves outside. North is up. Full city and 15 percent countryside margin visible, city about 70 percent of image width.
Composition: landscape 16:9 full-bleed game map. No text, labels, symbols for orientation, compass, UI, decorative borders, characters, clouds, rays or fog. Image is a visual style proposal, not a simulation export. IMPORTANT: do not reproduce the original reference's visible walls/facades or tilted perspective. Convert all architecture into literal roof-plan shapes; terrain is viewed flat from the zenith.

items.title: Zoom 02 · Several-city region — v002
items.alt: Overhead region retaining the same city in the centre, with a northwest foothill town, northeast forest town, southeast farm town and southwest coastal port.
items.body:
**Regional view.** The same city sits amid fields and roads. Its river runs south then southwest to the coastal port. Mountains remain northwest and dense woodland east. Four neighbouring cities and smaller settlements provide the intermediate scale.

Built-in image generation; input: Zoom 01.
items.prompt:
WORLD IN DREAMS coherent zoom series, frame 2 of 3: REGION. The supplied image is frame 1, the existing central city. This is an OUTWARD ZOOM of that EXACT location, not a new map. Reproduce the supplied city, orientation, circular footprint, river bends, bridges, market west of river, citadel in northeast and warehouses southeast faithfully as a smaller element at image centre, with its walls about 22 percent of the full image width. Shrink its details naturally to suit this scale. NORTH remains UP. Zoom out uniformly about 4 times; retain city and its immediate farmland rather than replacing it with a castle icon.
Invent the surrounding REGION around that fixed central city: the river enters the region from northern mountains slightly west of centre, flows south through that city retaining its curve east of the market, continues south and curves southwest to a western coast estuary near bottom-left. Tributaries JOIN this main river. A northwestern mountain ridge and pass, deep eastern woodland, southwest coastal farm belt, open southern grassland. Five other settlements: a small coastal port at lower-left, a town below northwestern foothills at upper-left, a forest-edge town at upper-right, a town in southern plains at lower-right and scattered villages and forts. Roads actually connect these places, with bridges at river crossings.
Style MUST match supplied image exactly: moderately stylised hand-painted classic-isekai game map, warm orange roofs, pale beige walls, yellow/green field patches, dark green tree crowns and saturated blue water, crisp small shapes, unified soft daylight and negligible shadows. STRICT VERTICAL CENITAL TOP-DOWN PLAN VIEW, camera at 90 degrees; ground is not tilted. Buildings are roof-plan shapes ONLY; no front or side facades or side-on town icons. Mountains are overhead ridge/shaded terrain seen from above, never side-on triangular mountains. Tree canopies viewed directly down, never rows of conical side-view trees. The land and sea lie on the same flat map plane. No isometric illustration, no horizon, no clouds, text, names, compass, labels, numbers, frame or UI.
Landscape 16:9 image, same orientation as reference. The result must read as the same game simply zoomed out, with several cities and their geographical connections visible. It is original illustrative preproduction art, not a simulation export.

items.title: Zoom 03 · Almost the whole continent — v002
items.alt: A unified overhead continent map with the earlier city and region left of centre, northwestern mountains, eastern forest, southwest bay, southern plains and dry southeast.
items.body:
**Continental view.** The preceding region remains left of centre, with its city, northwest mountains, eastern forest and southwest port recognisable. New coastlines, northern highlands, southern plains and a dry southeast extend the same world.

Built-in image generation; input: Zoom 02. Major geography is consistent for concept review; small building and terrain details are illustrative rather than a pixel-exact runtime zoom.

items.title: Earlier concept 01 · City general — Axel direction
items.alt: Original isekai city study with warm roof districts, enclosing walls, winding river, market, supply yards and farmland.
items.body:
## First generated concepts

**Reference chosen by the owner:** Isekai 01 — Axel. **Provider:** built-in image generation. **Version:** 001, 2026-11-11.

The image translates the warm roof palette, river, bridges and enclosing wall into a new city layout. The market, storage quarter and surrounding fields make trade and food supply readable.

**Visual review:** complete wall footprint, readable districts and supply access; no labels or UI. The camera is overhead but some building facades remain visible, so this is not yet a strictly vertical orthographic roof plan. City gates, wall-water crossings and bridge clearances need construction checks before implementation.

**Status:** earlier concept liked by the owner, retained for comparison. This is an independent composition, not an export of a simulation seed or an exact zoom into the regional concept.
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original World in Dreams environment study, settlement-scale general map. Use the supplied Axel image as the architectural and colour reference, not an edit target: warm red roof clusters, organic streets, enclosing pale stone walls, river, bridges, greenery and surrounding countryside. Create an ORIGINAL moderately stylised classic-isekai medieval trading city in a fertile plain, suitable for humans and other civil species. Camera MUST be perfectly vertical straight-down top-down, orthographic-style projection, no horizon, no perspective convergence, no isometric view, no visible building front facades. Roof plans, wall tops and ground surfaces dominate. Wide landscape image, city fills about 70 percent of the image with complete walls and neighbouring agricultural plots visible. A winding river crosses the town and exits the map, three believable bridges connect neighbourhoods, broad streets connect gates and market squares, narrower streets divide clearly readable blocks; supply roads connect fields, granaries, warehouses and caravan gate. Include modest dwellings, merchant quarters, a compact fortified civic precinct and gardens. One cohesive moderately detailed anime-painted visual language, simplified wood stone plaster and terracotta, clean roof silhouettes, natural daylight, short consistent shadows and readable paths. Preserve visible distinction between food production, trade and defence. Architecture-inspired by the reference but do not copy its exact layout. No text, UI, labels, watermarks, borders, characters, dramatic rays, fog or decorative cartographic legend. This is a visual proposal, not an engine screenshot.

items.title: Earlier concept 02 · Distant region — Re:Zero + Overlord direction
items.alt: Original colourful isekai region with a western coast, mountain ranges, forests, rivers, roads, walled cities, villages and forts.
items.body:
**References chosen by the owner:** Isekai 04 — Re:Zero regional world view, and Isekai 05 — Overlord regional geography. **Provider:** built-in image generation. **Version:** 001, 2026-11-11.

Re:Zero supplies living terrain colour and illustrated settlement hierarchy; Overlord supplies regional geography, barriers and map organisation. The result keeps terrain colours rather than a parchment overlay.

**Visual review:** coast, mountains, forest, dry country, city/village/fort hierarchy and connecting routes are readable without labels. Mountains and settlement symbols retain illustrative oblique relief; this is an overhead atlas, not a strict orthographic terrain sheet. River topology and road junctions are visual suggestions that still require engine validation.

**Status:** earlier concept liked by the owner, retained for comparison. This tests the more distant scale independently; it is not the same geography as Concept 01 and does not establish a continuous zoom transition yet.
